title: Engineering Summit
summaryLead: A marketing site that explains a Shopify planning product in seconds.
story: Summit is a product for Shopify agencies and consultants that turns scattered discovery notes into requirements, risk assessments, roadmaps and QA plans. Its audience lives in spreadsheets and inboxes, so the marketing site had to explain the product quickly and show its output, not just describe it. We built a lightweight, framework-free landing site where the workflow section and the score ring do most of the explaining.

features.title: Grain and fluid type
features.text: Paper grain from an SVG filter and headlines that scale with clamp(). No extra requests.
features.story: The paper-and-grain texture comes from an SVG noise filter embedded as a data URI, so it costs no image request. Headlines scale with clamp(), with no breakpoint overrides.

features.title: Workflow
features.text: From discovery notes to requirements, risk assessment, roadmap and QA plan.

features.title: CSS score ring
features.text: A conic-gradient donut with no chart library.
features.story: The score card shows a ring without Chart.js or D3. It is a conic-gradient with a centred pseudo-element, so it renders instantly with no runtime.
